name: Taking Care Of Children
overview: Scripture reveals that children are a precious heritage from the Lord, entrusted to parents who are commanded to keep God's words in their hearts as they raise them. Taking care of children involves loving discipline, including timely correction and the use of the rod, which fosters wisdom and prevents shame. Parents are called to diligently train their children in the way they should go, ensuring that God's guidance shapes their character and leads them to remain faithful throughout life.
